evidence_plan.requirement: Identify the most helpful pretraining task

payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the sentence reordering (SR) task is the most effective for pre-training, outperforming the other tasks.

claims.text: The sentence reordering (SR) task is the most effective pre-training task.
SR consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores compared to next sentence generation (NSG) and masked document generation (MDG).
Involving large scale data with the best performing pre-training task leads to significant performance improvements.
